note: These are typical seasonal patterns, not forecasts. For current weather use the India Meteorological Department and local advisories. Temperatures are described in general terms; no figures are quoted.

months.name: January
months.weather: Cold in the hills, with freezing nights above about 2,000 m; plains are cool and foggy.
months.snow: Snow likely in higher areas such as Auli, Chopta and Dhanaulti; Mukteshwar and Nainital may see some.
months.roads: Some high roads may be closed after snowfall.
months.treks: Winter treks like Kedarkantha, Brahmatal and Dayara Bugyal.
months.wildlife: Corbett is open in some zones; birdwatching is good.
months.festivals: Makar Sankranti and Uttarayani fairs. The Haridwar Ardh Kumbh is reported to begin on 14 January 2027.
months.crowd: Low except around Auli and winter holidays.

months.name: February
months.roads: Mostly open; some high roads closed.

months.name: March
months.weather: Spring begins; rhododendrons begin to bloom in the mid-hills.
months.festivals: Holi, including Kumaoni Baithaki Holi; the International Yoga Festival in Rishikesh is typically held around this time.

months.name: April
months.weather: Pleasant in the hills, hot in the plains.
months.roads: Open; Char Dham roads are readied.
months.chardham: Yamunotri and Gangotri typically open around Akshaya Tritiya; Kedarnath and Badrinath open late April or May.

months.name: May
months.weather: Warm; cool in the high hills.
months.roads: Open; heavy traffic on Char Dham routes.
months.crowd: Very high at hill stations and Char Dham.

months.name: June
months.weather: Hot in the plains; monsoon arrives in the second half.
months.snow: Snow remains only at high altitude.
months.roads: Landslide risk increases at month end.
months.treks: Valley of Flowers opens; high-altitude treks.
months.wildlife: Corbett: Dhikala and the other core zones close 15 June and Bijrani on 30 June; Jhirna, Dhela and Garjia stay open.
months.crowd: Very high early; drops with monsoon.

months.name: July
months.snow: None except at the highest altitudes.
months.treks: Valley of Flowers in bloom; many other treks are unsafe.
months.chardham: Open but risky because of landslides and flooding.
months.wildlife: Only Jhirna, Dhela and Garjia at Corbett stay open.
months.festivals: Harela (Kumaon); the Kanwar Yatra brings heavy crowds and traffic restrictions to Haridwar and Rishikesh.
months.crowd: Low at hill stations; high at Haridwar during Kanwar.

months.name: August
months.treks: Valley of Flowers; avoid most others.
months.wildlife: Only Jhirna, Dhela and Garjia at Corbett stay open.

months.name: September
months.weather: Monsoon retreats; skies begin to clear.
months.snow: Early snow at the highest altitudes.
months.roads: Improving, though landslides are still possible.
months.treks: Many treks reopen late in the month.
months.wildlife: Bijrani reopens 15 October; Dhikala and other core zones reopen 15 November.

months.name: October
months.weather: Clear, dry and cool; excellent visibility.
months.chardham: Open until closing in late October or November.
months.wildlife: Bijrani reopens 15 October; Dhikala and other core zones reopen 15 November.

months.name: November
months.roads: Good; high roads may close later.
months.chardham: Closes; dates are announced each year.
months.wildlife: Dhikala and other Corbett core zones reopen 15 November.
months.festivals: Kartik Purnima ritual bathing at Haridwar.

months.name: December
months.snow: Snow in higher areas; Dhanaulti and Chopta may see snow.
months.wildlife: Good for birds and some zones.
months.festivals: Christmas and New Year crowds in hill stations.
months.crowd: High around Christmas and New Year.

themes.pick: April-June and September-November; winter treks December-March
May-June and September-October for Char Dham; year-round for Haridwar and Rishikesh
Rafting roughly late September to June (dates set locally, and stopped when rivers are high); skiing at Auli January-March, snow permitting
Off-season weekdays; avoid May-June and holidays
